entry_resolution.rule: Resolve permission/provider before enabling actions: granted + provider ready → CAPTURE_READY; permission absent/requestable → CAPTURE_PERMISSION_REQUIRED; denied/not requestable → CAPTURE_PERMISSION_DENIED; provider failure → CAPTURE_ERROR.

states.meaning: Camera permission and provider are ready; Capture and Gallery are available.
Camera permission is missing and a platform request is available; Gallery remains independently available.
Permission was denied or is no longer requestable; camera capture is unavailable and Gallery remains available.
Provider, capture or media normalization failed; the page remains recoverable.
One readable normalized image is ready and handed to Recognition Processing.
The user leaves without creating a FishRecord.

transitions.guard: Camera request completed and provider can stream
Exactly one readable normalized image exists
Picker is independent of camera permission and image normalizes
System picker is available and image normalizes
System picker is available and image normalizes
System allows another request or settings return

policy: Camera permission is required only for the camera stream; denial never blocks the independent system Photo Picker.
The Capture host owns the camera lifecycle and releases it on exit, backgrounding or permission loss.
System permission and Photo Picker UI remain platform-owned; no system-icon replacement or frozen camera screenshot is introduced.
No Capture state creates a FishRecord; Save Catch belongs to Recognition Result.
